text: The purpose of this report is to facilitate a review of the detailed information on the 2022 Plan and Budget for TO Live as it relates to the St. Lawrence Centre (STLC) Redevelopment Committee.

The TO Live - St. Lawrence Centre Redevelopment Committee recommends that: 1. The Board of Directors of TO Live receive the report (May 21, 2021) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live for information.
